sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 300. Success value 100. 3x physical damage (Wind).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Frozen for 40 seconds with a success value of 130.
-Target: all allies. Increases wind elemental attack by 10 for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Removes debuffs and special debuffs.
-Target: all allies excluding yourself. Fills Unison gauge by 35.
-Target: yourself. Applies Armament for 90 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; increases ATK and MATK by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
Boosts stats of Monsters of all elements by 40% when equipped in the Main Slot.
